# Beaconmon

> Beaconmon is a website uptime and performance monitoring service for freelancers and agencies.

Beaconmon checks your websites every 30 seconds and sends instant alerts when something breaks — downtime, slow responses, SSL certificate expiry, domain expiry, or unexpected content changes. It is designed for freelancers, agencies, and small e-commerce businesses who manage multiple client sites.

## What Beaconmon does

- **HTTP uptime monitoring** — checks every 30 seconds (Business plan) or 1 minute (Pro), alerts on non-2xx responses or slow load times
- **SSL certificate monitoring** — tiered warnings at 30, 14, and 7 days before expiry
- **Domain expiry tracking** — WHOIS-based alerts at 30, 14, and 7 days before renewal
- **TCP port monitoring** — verifies any port is open and accepting connections
- **Keyword monitoring** — confirms a word or phrase is (or isn't) present in the page body
- **Content change detection** — notifies when any HTML content changes at a CSS selector

## Alert channels

Email, Slack, webhook. SMS available on Business plan.

## Public status pages

Every plan includes public status pages showing 90-day uptime history, active incidents, and incident history. Custom domains supported.

## Pricing

- **Free** — 10 monitors, 5-minute check interval, 1 status page, no credit card required
- **Pro** — $19/month (or $15/month annual) — 25 monitors, 1-minute checks, 5 alert channels, 3 status pages
- **Business** — $59/month (or $47/month annual) — unlimited monitors, 30-second checks, unlimited everything, SLO tracking, multi-location checks

All plans include a 14-day Pro trial with no credit card required.
